Players Committee card image of [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]] (Virtual Set 13), re-issued 17 December 2020 with a new icon at top left (lightsaber icon in place of the Rebel Alliance emblem), original game text, no errata mark. Uploaded unchanged.
